$comment: Model profiles: what Relay changes when the main Claude Code session runs on a given model. The first profile with a `match` entry inside the session's model id or alias applies; no match is the `default` route (Relay as before). Edit, then run `relay build`: it embeds the profiles and the texts in profiles/overlays/ in hooks/register.ts. Codex has no profiles.

frontier.$comment: The model behind the fable-lead route's judgment roles. Under a tight budget it falls back to the strong tier of config/routing.json.

escalation.$comment: One fix round on the frontier model after implementer-deep's rounds, before the conductor adjudicates. The conductor dispatches implementer-deep named lane-<id>-<agentSuffix> with this effort.

frontierCap.$comment: Percent of the usage window above which frontier spawns fall back to the strong tier.

lead.$comment: Text added to these Relay skills when the main session expands them. `belowEffort`: only while the session's effort is under that level.

spawnOverlays.$comment: Text added to the brief of a Relay agent that this profile sends to the frontier model.
